topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture's learning objectives, contextualises the material with previous lectures, and outlines the Hanahan and Weinberg hallmarks of cancer framework.

topics.label: Deregulated growth and inhibitory signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in signaling cascades, including Wnt/beta-catenin, RTK/Ras/MAPK, PI3K/Akt, and TGF-beta, confer proliferative independence and resistance to growth-inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Differentiation block in hematopoietic and epithelial cancers
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics illustrate how failure of cancer cells to exit the cell cycle and complete terminal differentiation contributes to malignancy in leukemias and colorectal dysplasia.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis via the p53 pathway
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the molecular mechanisms of apoptotic resistance in cancer, focusing on p53 disruption and the mitochondrial balance between Bax and Bcl-2.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, telomere biology, and senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells bypass the Hayflick limit through telomerase activation while contrasting this with normal p53-mediated stress and senescent fail-safe mechanisms.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the Warburg effect, aerobic glycolysis, and how mutations in Krebs cycle enzymes generate oncometabolites that alter epigenetic regulation.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and the angiogenic switch
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes the balance of pro- and anti-angiogenic factors required to stimulate new blood vessel formation to support tumor growth and overcome hypoxia.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze the metastatic cascade, the mechanical and environmental factors behind seed-and-soil colonization, and the clonal genomic features of secondary tumors.

topics.label: Closing summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic synthesizes the lecture's coverage of cancer hallmarks, references contemporary literature, and outlines upcoming practicals.
